### E. Prerequisites (each edge separately)

**P1 — `savings_ext_overdraft_replenishment_transfer` ← `savings_ext_counted_withdrawal_fee_assessment` (value_input, gate `fees_net`).**
- Entailment basis: blocked side — 270be751 "The fee burden describes what the account carries for the cycle as the charter settles it. It is read from a cycle record on which each excess withdrawal fee the charter makes due for the cycle stands charged … A total read from a record that lacks a fee the charter makes due … is not the figure this policy defines." Depended-on rules — 91698fce, a62461d6, 01e6da44, 7244e2e4, 73c151db. Records — seven counted withdrawals, each on its own date, against a free allowance of 6; no fee on the seventh.
- Strength: hard in both (source: counted only after; KB: otherwise "not the figure this policy defines").
- Stated anywhere? No. No document names the reconciliation, its tool, or a sequence in connection with the replenishment.

**P2 — `savings_ext_overdraft_replenishment_transfer` ← `savings_ext_certificate_funding_fee_refund` (value_input, gate `fees_net`).**
- Entailment basis: blocked side — 270be751 "… and each refund of such a fee that the account is entitled to stands credited … or lacks a refund the account is entitled to, is not the figure". Depended-on rules — 83932a6d, 4a8e5e94, b0c6e2c8, 819a75a9. Records — the 15.00 excess fee on the 2026-08-28 internal transfer to CD 2270, no refund.
- Strength: hard — same. Stated anywhere? No.

**P3 — `savings_ext_counted_withdrawal_fee_assessment` ← `savings_ext_certificate_funding_fee_refund` (value_input, gate `voided`).**
- Entailment basis: blocked side — a62461d6 "a fee of the cycle with no bank-error refund sits on a counted withdrawal past the allowance, in posting order; a fee of the cycle that carries a bank-error refund sits on some withdrawal other than a counted withdrawal past the allowance … A cycle that departs from any of this is not squared under this policy." together with the standing-fee count ("the cycle's excess withdrawal fee entries less the bank-error refunds of excess withdrawal fees belonging to the cycle"). Depended-on rules — as P2. Records — the fee sits on an internal transfer (never counted) with no refund.
- Strength: hard (not squared) — same; and weight-bearing (without the refund the standing count 1 leaves 0 fees due).
- Stated anywhere? The closest sentence is a62461d6 "A fee resting on a withdrawal the charter never charges, left standing with no bank-error refund, is one such departure." It is an instance of the blocked side's own application condition (the source's "every excess withdrawal fee of the cycle that has not been refunded as bank_error sits on a counted withdrawal beyond the allowance"), phrased as what the reconciliation must not rest on; it names neither the funding-fee policy, nor its tool, nor an order. Judged principle-level, the same category as 270be751's settled-record principle. Recorded here so a later revision can re-weigh it; not counted as a statement of P3.
- The depended-on documents (83932a6d, 4a8e5e94, b0c6e2c8, 819a75a9) do not restate the reconciliation's or the replenishment's principle: confirmed.

No workflow is claimed by task 1.
